description: This file contains shell script functions and variables related to platform-specific upgrade processes for a device, including configurations for firmware upgrade, environment settings, and device-specific partition adjustments.

methods.name: tplink_sg2xxx_fix_mtdparts
methods.description: Configures MTD partition layout and baud rate for TP-Link devices and sets environment variables accordingly.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the firmware image, always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade based on device type, adjusting MTD partitions and calling the default upgrade method.
